item.title: Putin Rejects US Peace Proposal to End the Ukraine War
item.description: The Kremlin wants to carve out a large piece of Ukraine and has rejected any agreement that would be acceptable to Ukrainians. The post Putin Rejects US Peace Proposal to End the Ukraine War appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Ukraine’s Oil Attacks on Russia Aren’t Helping Much
item.description: Ukraine’s oil attacks on Russia have done little to curb Russian oil production and export. Paradoxically, they may have even helped the Kremlin benefit from higher prices. The post Why Ukraine’s Oil Attacks on Russia Aren’t Helping Much appeared first on The National Interest.
